correctness.rationale: The stationary causal convolution uniquely defines the invariant process. Conditioning on shared Poisson intervals and using exact uniform-sphere fourth moments gives the positive clock-variance term minus negative same-orientation term. Exponential renewal moments give the stated rational polynomial, independently reproduced by a closed stationary-generator hierarchy; 2731 exact-rational assertions replay the identity but do not prove the universal assertion. For d<=4 every coefficient of the numerator polynomial is negative, and for d>=5 there is exactly one sign change, proving exactly one positive root. At the equal-stiffness root, the polynomial is affine with strictly positive derivative in ab, yielding the sharp anisotropy threshold delay. Independent thermal Brownian noises contribute additive constants to conditional squared-axis moments, which cancel in the cross covariance.
